summary: Wired lib/suite-selection-lib.sh's covering-suite selector into verify-deploy.sh's Gate 8 via a new opt-in --gate8-touched input: a mappable touched path narrows Gate 8's internal run-all.sh invocation to its covering suite(s); absent the flag, behavior is byte-identical. A narrowed run, pass or fail, is forced onto GATE_DIRTY_LIST so it can never write a full-corpus --skip-unchanged cache entry. Added a 22-case regression suite, documented the mechanism and its coverage trade-off in two context docs, redeployed cleanly, and sequenced task 585 after this one via a dependencies[] edge. Found and fixed two real defects beyond the plan's own pseudocode during implementation (a bash empty-array argument-expansion bug that made every unnarrowed run fail with exit 2, and a variable-default-declaration ordering bug that silently clobbered the flag's parsed value).
